name: walkthrough
description: Walk an app end to end and publish what you actually saw — web, iOS, Android, desktop or CLI. Drives the real app, captures every state, and writes a catalog, per-feature walkthroughs, persona journeys, verified fixes and an append-only run log into a Walkthrough Studio hub. Use when the user says /walkthrough, or wants to document, record, screenshot, demo or QA their app, generate onboarding guides, walk a user journey, verify a bug fix holds, or open a PR showing what a change does for the user.

interface.shortDescription: Walk any app — web, mobile, desktop or CLI — and publish what you saw.
interface.longDescription: Drives a real application the way a person would and writes down what it saw. Discovers features, captures each state on every surface, walks persona journeys, verifies that bug fixes hold, and records every run against a git commit so you always know whether the documentation still matches the product.
defaultPrompt: Walk this app and document it.
Capture a walkthrough of the checkout flow on mobile.
Walk the product as a new user and write up the journey.
Verify the bug fixes from the last two weeks still hold.
